questions.question: Against which nation is judgment especially focused in Isaiah 34?
What is the scope of the judgment in Isaiah 34?
options: The single city of Babylon alone
The land of Edom and nothing more
All the nations and the host of heaven
The tribes of Israel who had sinned
questions.answer: All the nations and the host of heaven

questions.question: Isaiah 34 says the land of Edom will become desolate, inhabited by wild creatures.
